Exercise: BARBELL ROMANIAN DEADLIFT lowered position. Feet hip-width, whole soles grounded; knees softly bent about20degrees, hips pushed far backward, torso inclined roughly30degrees above horizontal with long neutral spine and aligned neck. Straight arms hang vertically, closed overhand shoulder-width grips; continuous straight bar skims front of upper shins just below knees. Modest equal graphite plates and collars outside legs clear of floor. This is a hip hinge, not a squat; shins nearly vertical. SIDE-biased rear three-quarter view showing flat back, hips back, bar close to shins, hamstring backs of thighs exposed below shorts. Highlight visible hamstrings only; glutes covered.

review.notes: Hip hinge with hips back, slight knee flexion and bar at upper shin; straight arms, grounded soles and neutral back visible. Rear-side view shows hamstrings below shorts; hidden far grip partly occluded.
review.independentNotes: Viewed full image: hip hinge with softly bent knees, straight arms and bar just below knees; lifted plates and posterior-thigh cues distinguish mid-descent from floor setup.
